scenario: barricaded inside a movie theater projection room
part1_script: A movie theater projection booth is built like a vault. The heavy steel door only locks from inside. It is 3:15 in the morning. You stockpiled 40 gallons of soda syrup and 90 candy boxes. You wedged two 900-pound film projectors against the entrance. Nothing outside can force its way in. The soundproof observation window looks down into Theater 4. Below, 50 infected roam in the dark. At 4:00 AM, the emergency generator suddenly hums alive. The projector fires up and blares loud sound. Fifty heads turn. They sprint up and smash through the glass— Comment Part 2 if you want to see how you survive.
